import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load and aggregate the CSV values to one revenue value per month and region.
df = pd.read_csv('/mnt/uploads/sales.csv')
grouped = df.groupby(['month', 'region'], as_index=False)['revenue'].sum()
wide = grouped.pivot(index='month', columns='region', values='revenue').sort_index()

fig, ax = plt.subplots()
for region in wide.columns:
    ax.plot(wide.index, wide[region], marker='o', label=region)
ax.set_yscale('symlog')
ax.set_xlabel('Month')
ax.set_ylabel('Revenue (USD)')
ax.legend()
fig.tight_layout()
plt.show()
